findings.title: No size cap between a staged draft and the conformance check: the check command reads the whole draft and plan_quality scans it, so a very large draft stalls the check and uses several GB of memory.
findings.evidence: .claude/agents/idea-planner.md:209 and agent-workflows/idea-planner-agent.md:198 (f.read()); src/governance/plan_quality.py:103, :156, :168. A 2 GB file: 51.4 s and about 4.2 GB peak RSS; a 200 MB draft about 9 s.
findings.consequence: An accidental runaway draft can exceed a command timeout or exhaust memory. Predates cycle 10.
